message: The other day, I realized it had been ages since I checked the batteries in our smoke alarms. So, I turned it into a little family event—my kids helped me climb on chairs, and we made a game of testing each one. 🔔 As we went from room to room, we chatted about our escape plan and even drew a silly map. It turned what could’ve been a chore into a cozy evening of bonding. Just a friendly reminder to keep those alarms in check, and maybe have a little fun while you’re at it! How do you make safety feel less like a task?
